summary: Transform your approach to program design with our training course. Learn to seamlessly integrate learning for successful implementation and lasting impact!
lede: Program design and implementation training that integrates learning helps program professionals build reflection and adaptation into initiatives. It is for program managers, implementers and evaluation specialists who need to improve programs as they run. Participants learn to define learning objectives, create feedback loops, and use monitoring and evaluation findings plus stakeholder input to guide adjustments and continuous improvement.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for designing, implementing, and evaluating programs across multiple sectors.
modules: Why Learning Matters in Program Design
Monitoring and Evaluation as a Learning Tool
Engaging Stakeholders in the Learning Process
Overcoming Common Challenges in Learning Integration
